gen.title: How federal impeachment moves from charges to verdict
gen.orderNote: Follow the numbered order shown on the page

steps.label: House introduces impeachment charges
steps.quote: 1. The House of Representatives brings articles (charges) of impeachment against an official.

steps.label: House votes to impeach official
steps.quote: 2. If the House adopts the articles by a simple majority vote, the official has been impeached.

steps.label: Senate holds impeachment trial
steps.quote: 3. The Senate holds an impeachment trial. In the case of a president, the U.S. Supreme Court chief justice presides.

steps.label: Official removed after guilty verdict
steps.quote: 4. If found guilty, the official is removed from office.

steps.label: Official continues after acquittal
steps.quote: 5. If they are not found guilty, they may continue to serve in office.
